sections.title: Hotfix Balance Update
sections.description: This is a Hero balance hotfix. Replay codes from the April 22, 2025 patch are still available.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: We want to make sure that every Hero has answers to their potential counter so we're increasing D.Va's ability to combat Zarya’s beam damage.

general.text_en: Plot Armor – Rare Hero Survival Item
general.subject: health

general.text_en: Increased damage reduction against Beams to 65% (up from 30%).

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Every Hero generates Stadium Cash from dealing damage and healing at a rate unique to them which we’re monitoring carefully. We think we set the rate of Cassidy’s earnings too high and he's earning a bit too much Stadium Cash, allowing him to consistently get MVPs and buy late game Items early on.

general.text_en: Reduced the amount of Stadium Cash Cassidy gains from dealing damage and healing to 40% (down from 50%).

blocks.title: Salvaged Slugs – Epic Weapon Item
blocks.body: Increased ammo restoration chance to 50% (up from 40%). Increased damage to barriers to 30% (up from 25%).
blocks.dev: Developer Comments: Reinhardt and Zarya have been performing well so far. We're increasing the power of this Item to help players combat their powerful barriers.

blocks.title: Volskaya Ordnance – Epic Weapon Item
blocks.body: Increased the weapon damage per 100 Max Life to 5% (up from 3%). Increased the extra weapon damage capacity to 20% (up from 15%).
blocks.dev: Developer Comments: We've observed that sometimes tanks can be a bit too... well, tanky! Volskaya Ordnance was a tough Item to make work for not a big enough pay off, so we're adding a little bit of power here to make it a more efficient Item to buy in those cases.

blocks.title: Iron Eyes – Rare Survival Item
blocks.body: Damage Reduction against incoming Critical Hits increased to 20% (up from 15%).
blocks.dev: Developer Comments: We're increasing the Damage Reduction of Iron Eyes to give players more powerful tools to combat builds with high burst damage.

blocks.title: Reinforced Titanium – Rare Survival Item
blocks.body: Damage Reduction against incoming Ability Damage while you have Shields increased to 15% (up from 10%).
blocks.dev: Developer Comments: We're increasing the Damage Reduction of Reinforced Titanium to give players more powerful tools to combat builds with high burst damage.

blocks.title: General
blocks.body: Fixed an issue where Competitive Points are not granted if the match ends early because one team left entirely. Fixed an issue where Overhealth is consumed on top of normal damage if the total amount of damage is more than the current amount of Overhealth on that hero.
